runs.answer: The annual administrative fee is 24.00 EUR. For a 240-litre bin collected fortnightly, there are 26 collections per year. The handbook does not specify the per-collection fee, so the total cost cannot be computed without that information. Contact the waste service directly for the per-collection fee.
The handbook does not cover forms for changing bank details on waste collection invoices. Contact the waste management service directly for the correct form.
The handbook does not cover online certificate of residence requests or their costs. Contact the Remerbaach municipal office directly for details.

A 120-litre bin costs 5.20 EUR per collection. Weekly collection means 52 collections per year. The administrative fee is not mentioned in the handbook. Thus, the total cost for a year is 5.20 EUR × 52 = 270.40 EUR.
